text:
sahil: paging: noticing a sudden p95 spike for text-gen endpoints in us-west. p95 ~1.2s (baseline ~0.35s), throughput down ~40% across a handful of pods. raising page now.
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-09 created (performance). Severity: P2. Pager sent to oncall-amber.
oncall-amber: taking it. any stack traces or pod restarts?
sahil: no obvious OOMs. small increase in KV cache misses, node CPU on a couple of pods hit 90%. logs show repeated kvcache.eviction warnings. attaching quick snippet: 
```
[2026-03-17T03:22:11Z] kvcache: evict key shard-42 size=24MB reason=memory_pressure
[2026-03-17T03:22:11Z] runtime: continous_batcher: backlog rising to 180
```

maria: routing shows spike concentrated on us-west-2b; other zones stable. looks like a localized node pool degradation.
ops-lead: possible noisy tenant or infra flake. we should: 1) temporarily ramp capacity in us-west 2) route new requests to healthy zones 3) enable fallback to smaller model variant for non-SLAs.
jess-prod-comm: I'll draft a short status update once we confirm impact and ETA. suggested short blurb: "We are investigating elevated latency for text-generation in US‑West. Mitigations in progress; some customers may see degraded p95 and reduced throughput. More updates in 15 mins." ok?
oncall-amber: starting mitigation steps now: cordon/recreate two suspect nodes, scale up autoscaler target by +30% in us-west, and apply a temporary routing rule to prefer other AZs for new sessions.
sahil: started quick canary restart of affected deployment with memory flags turned on (kv cache GC more aggressive). also enabling prefix-KV warm cache for high-traffic tenants.
jess-prod-comm: draft for status.redwood.com: 
"We are investigating increased latency and reduced throughput for text-generation in US‑West. We have applied mitigations including instance restarts, autoscaler increase, and routing adjustments. Customers may see intermittent 2x p95 for up to 30 minutes. We will provide another update within 15 minutes."
maria: confirming routing change applied, traffic shift ~65% away from 2b within 90s. inbound qps in 2b down 60% now.
ops-lead: good. please also enable model-fallback policy for low-priority routes (variant: tgen-medium) to reduce KV pressure.
oncall-amber: model-fallback enabled for non-payg routes. monitoring for error rate regressions.
sahil: after restarts, CPU on the two nodes dropped to ~45%, backlog reduced, p95 improved to ~0.55s for affected pods. cluster-wide p95 now ~0.6s (still above baseline). throughput recovering to ~85% of normal.
incident-bot: Update: Mitigation in progress. Assigned to oncall-amber & sahil.
jess-prod-comm: posting status page update now. copying customer advisory to company channels soon.
ops-lead: suggested CS template: "We observed a performance degradation impacting text-generation in US‑West that may have caused slower responses or reduced throughput. Mitigations are in place (node restarts, routing adjustments, fallback model) and we expect recovery within 30–45 minutes. If you experienced errors or degraded quality, please reply to this message or open a support ticket and reference INC-2026-09." fine to send?
maria: +1, keep "expect recovery" conservative given restarts.
oncall-amber: monitoring for 10 more minutes. p95 trending down to 0.42s. will notify when back to baseline for 5m window.
sahil: also adding a short post-incident action: investigate KV cache sizing, increase eviction thresholds, and add noisy-tenant throttles.
jess-prod-comm: sent status.redwood.com update and customer emails to tiered list. pasted advisory to #customers and CS team.
ops-lead: nice. after we resolve, let's prepare an internal RCA template: timeline, root cause hypothesis (node-local memory pressure + KV churn), mitigations taken, follow-ups (cache sizing, autoscaling tuning, routing policy tests, playbook updates).
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-09 status changed to "Mitigating". Priority: P2.
oncall-amber: marking handoff to daytime shift at 06:00 UTC, leaving mitigation steps and watchlist.
sahil: confirmed handoff. final note: temporary customer-facing hits have been minimized; still watching.
ops-lead: thanks team. will update again after confirmation of stable 5m baseline or if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
jess-prod-comm: (for record) final posted customer advisory link: https://status.redwood.com/INC-2026-09
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-09: last update at 03:27 UTC."
